description:
Currently only crate-jmap-mail-server/ has an AGENTS.md among the eight server crates (mail, chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata). The mail one self-describes as the canonical extension-server template.

Discovered during JMAP-ga0q.2 (identity-seam policy doc sweep): that bead instructed adding a 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical' section to crate-jmap-chat-server/AGENTS.md. The file does not exist.

Two coherent paths forward:

  A. Sibling-crate AGENTS.md is optional. Permission-policy notes go in lib.rs module doc or in the existing canonical mail-server AGENTS.md. Close JMAP-ga0q.2 partial-conformance on the chat-server site.

  B. Every extension-server crate gets a cookie-cutter AGENTS.md mirroring mail-server's. File a sweep bead under JMAP-sc1b (or a new epic) to create the seven missing files. Then close JMAP-ga0q.2 once chat-server's is added.

The workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' table implies (B) is the intended cookie-cutter posture — the lack of files in 7 of 8 server crates may itself be a publish-readiness gap.

This bead exists because /do-beads hit the question during JMAP-ga0q.2 work and cannot pick a path without explicit user direction. Recommendation: pursue (B) under JMAP-sc1b, schedule a sweep bead; in the meantime, close JMAP-ga0q.2 noting partial conformance on the chat-server site.

## Acceptance

  - User picks (A) or (B), recorded in a comment here.
  - If (B), a sweep bead is filed listing the seven missing AGENTS.md sites.
  - JMAP-ga0q.2 is closed (either way; the question above unblocks its final site).
notes:
Decision (2026-05-11, Mark): B — cookie-cut AGENTS.md into all 7 missing extension-server siblings.

Sweep bead filed: JMAP-sc1b.109 (parent JMAP-sc1b publish-readiness epic, P3).

JMAP-ga0q.2's chat-server site is now functionally covered by the sweep bead (lib.rs module-doc stopgap from ga0q.2's close-message remains in place; sweep will move that text into chat-server/AGENTS.md and remove the lib.rs duplicate).
title: Decide policy: should each extension *-server crate have an AGENTS.md?
